csv_project_name: Engineering for Port Orchard Intermodal Terminal Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: Kitsap Transit is issuing this Request for Qualifications ("RFQ") to solicit proposals from interested, qualified, and experienced firms to provide Preliminary Engineering (including NEPA and permitting support) and design services necessary to advance the phased rehabilitation of the Port Orchard Intermodal Terminal. The selected Consultant team shall support project definition, design criteria development, marine operations needs assessment, focused alternatives analysis, phasing and packaging recommendations, preliminary engineering, environmental and permitting support, design development, cost estimating, and preparation of final bid-ready PS&E documentation, as authorized by Kitsap Transit.

services: Preliminary engineering; rehabilitation and refurbishment planning; civil engineering; environmental engineering/planning/design; NEPA and permitting support; cost estimating; design development; final bid-ready PS&E documentation.
relevance_explanation:
- Includes genuine engineering and design services, not only consulting.
- Rehabilitation of a transport terminal may involve structural work, but no specific bridge, long-span roof, or special structural system is described.
- Marine/intermodal terminal focus is outside sbp's core priority areas unless significant special structures are involved.
- Early-stage engineering and phased rehabilitation offer some strategic entry potential.
- Lack of concrete structural complexity, spans, or architecturally demanding elements limits relevance.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated. Available fee-related basis: total construction cost is 17.0 million USD; services cover preliminary engineering through final bid-ready PS&E, plus NEPA/permitting support and cost estimating.
references_qualifications: Interested firms must be qualified and experienced to provide preliminary engineering, NEPA and permitting support, and design services for phased terminal rehabilitation. Specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are not stated in the source.
